subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice submission channel decision & data capture requirements
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@oakbridge.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice submission channel decision & data capture requirements

Hi Olivia,

Thanks for starting the onboarding paperwork. To get Oakbridge live in Redwood's supplier ledger we need to decide two things quickly:

1) Intake channel: portal (preferred) vs direct email (SMTP)
   - Portal pros: structured onboarding form, idempotent submission, automatic PO-linking, better audit trail
   - Email pros: less vendor lift, PDF/PDF+CSV attachments supported
2) Minimal invoice fields we require so AP can auto-match to POs and process in 7-day SLA
   - Required for us: Redwood PO number, invoice number, invoice date (YYYY-MM-DD), line items with unit price, quantity, tax amount, currency, remit-to entity

Questions for you (short answers encouraged):
- Can Oakbridge submit via a web portal? If not, can you provide an SMTP endpoint and any sending IP ranges?
- Do you have an ERP that can export a compact XML/CSV invoice? (attaching our onboarding form for reference)

I've attached the vendor_onboarding_form.pdf and a sample_invoice_template.xml. Karhtik (cc'd) will confirm PO-stamping needs; Vanessa will coordinate finance acceptance.

Next steps: Please confirm channel preference and attach a sample invoice (PDF or XML) so we can validate field mapping.

Best,

Stephanie Nguyen
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0143

Attachments:
- vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF)
- sample_invoice_template.xml (XML example)

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@oakbridge.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice submission channel decision & data capture requirements

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks — appreciate the clarity.

Short answers:
- Portal: yes, we can use a portal (preferred). Our finance team prefers SFTP/portal over direct SMTP for tracking.
- ERP export: We can generate XML or a compact CSV. I'll attach a sanitized sample XML and a one-page internal invoice PDF so you can validate headers.

Notes:
- Oakbridge will need Redwood to accept multi-PO invoices (we sometimes ship against multiple POs on a single invoice).
- Can you confirm whether you need PO numbers on each line or a top-level PO references array? Our ERP usually exports a PO column per line.

Attaching: sample_invoice_export.xml, example_invoice.pdf

Regards,

Olivia Chen

Oakbridge Manufacturing
olivia.chen@oakbridge.com | +1 617-555-0199

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 10:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice submission channel decision & data capture requirements

Stephanie / Olivia — quick technical checks from the serving side:

On PO linking and multi-PO invoices:
- We prefer PO on each line for automatic matching. If Oakbridge exports a PO column per line that's ideal. We can also accept a top-level PO array but will need mapping during onboarding.

On channel and idempotency:
- Portal (preferred) supports idempotency tokens and SFTP submission for larger batches. If Oakbridge must use SMTP we need sender IPs and DKIM/SPF records to whitelist. Email-based PDFs will require OCR fallback and have a higher exception rate.

Field-level asks (can Oakbridge confirm these exist in the XML sample you attached?):
- line_item[].description
- line_item[].po_number
- line_item[].unit_price
- line_item[].quantity
- tax_amount (per-line or total)
- currency (ISO 4217)
- remit_to_entity_id

Olivia — can you re-send the XML with a sample line where tax_amount is split per-line and an example of a multi-PO invoice? I attached a quick screenshot (po-stamp-example.png) that shows how our PO-stamp logic expects the field.

If portal is acceptable, we'll provision an onboarding token and a short API spec for Oakbridge's ERP export.

Thanks,

Karthik Iyer
Vendor Integration Engineer | Redwood
karthik@redwood.com

Attachments:
- po-stamp-example.png (PNG)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice submission channel decision & data capture requirements

Olivia — thanks for the quick turnaround and the sample files.

Decision and next steps (short):
- Channel: Portal (Oakbridge confirmed) — Redwood onboarding token and SFTP details will be sent by Monday.
- Invoice template: We will accept XML or CSV with PO-per-line. Please ensure PO numbers are present on each line item to enable automated matching.
- Multi-POs: Supported. If multiple POs appear on a single invoice, include a 'po_number' column per line; our matching restores splits automatically.
- Action for Oakbridge: Please complete vendor_onboarding_form.pdf, add a sanitized multi-PO XML sample (attach), and return both. We'll run a test ingest in the sandbox and report exceptions.

Vanessa — please prepare a short AP acceptance note (fields required + SLA) and a low-risk exception path for OCR-ing PDFs if the portal occasionally fails.

Olivia — attaching the DocuSign link for the onboarding packet: DocuSign: 0x9af3d. Expect provisioning email by 2026-07-20.

Best,

Stephanie Nguyen
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
